messages:
Alex W: FYI pushed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 that changes how auth tokens are minted for Dedicated + Private deployments. It's mostly an env var refactor + narrowing the KMS key alias scope. Need security review on KMS scope and secrets handling. Planning to merge in the Thu maintenance window (2026-03-19 03:00 UTC). CC @Lina @Samira — ping if you need more context.
Samira K: taking a look. Quick checklist off the top of my head: 1) no plaintext secrets committed 2) vault paths updated and env mappings validated 3) audit events emitted on token issuance 4) rollout is backward-compatible so older nodes keep working during canary. I’ll scan the vault path changes now.
Dan: small nit: please add a unit test for TokenService that asserts we don't fall back to legacy env var names. Also would be good to ensure CI runs the smoke on Dedicated-only infra. I can queue a review once tests land.
Lina: looking now :eyes: main thing for me is the KMS alias narrowing — add a short comment in the code documenting why we prefer the alias and what fallback (if any) exists. Also add an explicit audit log emit when the key is used. I can approve after that. @sec-bot please run key-scope scan.
sec-bot: Automated secret scan: detected string 'TEST_KMS_KEY' in tests/fixtures/token_fixture.go:12 — low severity (test fixture). File excluded from prod builds but recommend replacing with a generated fixture to avoid accidental copy/paste.
Alex W: thanks — pushed fix in 4823 -> 4823.1: replaced fixture with generator, added comment about fallback behavior, added audit log emit (commit abc123). Also added the unit test Dan asked for. CI is still flaky on e2e though. @Dan any suggestions to reduce flakes?
Dan: try updating the e2e invocation to `ci/e2e --retry 2 --timeout 12m` in the pipeline file; that helped on other PRs. I can open a tiny follow-up PR to the pipeline if you want. Also tag this PR with `merge-on-green` once checks look stable.
Lina: approved from security side :+1: please include the HSM rotation doc link in the PR description and add an audit event name (e.g. `audit:token:issue`) to the schema. After CI is green I'm good for merge.
Alex W: added doc link to PR description: https://internal.redwood/docs/hsm-rotation and added the `audit:token:issue` event to the schema. Marked PR as `merge-on-green`. Targeting Thu 03:00 UTC window. Thank you!
sec-bot: CI results: all required checks passed. e2e retry reduced flakiness (1 flaky test marked for follow-up).
Alex W: merged and deployed to staging, watching logs now. If no regressions we'll promote in the Thu prod window. Huge thanks everyone :tada:
